name: India
access: Foreign investors register as FPIs with a PAN; shorting only in the F&O-segment list (SEBI framework of 5 January 2024), institutions must flag shorts at order entry, cannot square off intraday, and every short is reported; SLB through the clearing corporations is thin; sector foreign-ownership limits bind on more than 10% of the market; STT 0.1% each side on delivery trades.
data_notes: Every name lists on NSE and BSE (.NS and .BO): NSE only. Quarterly frames have 3 columns for several names; cash-flow statements are annual.
coverage_notes: statement counts for 400 names, profile count for 0
